pages.text: What rises is hostile, immune to the plague, and its blows can pass the sickness on. Flies follow the Afflicted everywhere: you will see them before they see you.$(br2)Each beast keeps a trick from its old life.

pages.name: Afflicted Cow
pages.text: Slow and heavy. Bursts into a miasma cloud when it dies.

pages.name: Afflicted Pig
pages.text: Wounded badly, it shrieks and goes into a frenzy.

pages.name: Afflicted Sheep
pages.text: Its rotten fleece sheds miasma when struck.

pages.name: Afflicted Horse
pages.text: Its kick throws you through the air.

pages.name: Afflicted Wolf
pages.text: Howls when it finds prey, and every Afflicted nearby joins the hunt.

pages.name: Afflicted Villager
pages.text: Opens doors, and never stops coughing: stand too close without a mask and you may catch pneumonic plague from it.
